tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: What Minos serves: live dictionary releases (ICD-10 PL, ICD-9 PL, ICD-11 PL) with versions, validity and licences, JGP grouping availability and knowledge horizon, the tool list and the disclaimer.

tools.name: search_codes
tools.description: Search Polish medical codes by code or Polish words (diacritics optional), like the minoshealth.pl search: ICD-10 PL diagnoses, ICD-9 PL procedures, JGP groups and, on request, pre-released ICD-11 PL. service_date (default today in Poland) picks the release in force; JGP groups are always searched i

tools.name: get_code
tools.description: Everything the code page shows for one ICD-10 PL, ICD-9 PL or ICD-11 PL code: title, place in the hierarchy (ICD-11 blocks included), child codes, notes (includes, excludes, index terms; counted), attributes (English name, CZS status and dates, WHO URI, definition), ICD-9 procedure rank, WHO ICD-10/

tools.name: browse_codes
tools.description: List one level of a classification: the chapters when parent and node are omitted, else the children of the parent code or of a node id from an earlier listing (ICD-11 blocks have a node id but no code). Each child says whether it has children. Long levels stop at 400 entries with truncated=true.

tools.name: map_icd10_icd11
tools.description: WHO ICD-10/ICD-11 mapping table rows for one code, verbatim: to_icd11 reads both 10-to-11 tables for a Polish ICD-10 code, to_icd10 the 11-to-10 table for an ICD-11 code. Rows give the WHO table, source row, codes, titles and the ICD-11 URI; WHO states no match type. The tables' ICD-10 side is WHO I

tools.name: get_jgp_group
tools.description: One JGP group in the catalog in force on service_date (default today in Poland): name, product code, base points per catalog column, scopes, the act and release behind it, the knowledge horizon, and its grouping conditions from the characteristics with the directional lists they name (read a list wi

tools.name: get_jgp_list
tools.description: The codes of one directional diagnosis or procedure list from the JGP characteristics (attachment 9), by the list id and catalog that get_jgp_group names, one page at a time, on service_date (default today in Poland).

tools.name: browse_jgp_catalog
tools.description: Browse the JGP catalog in force on service_date (default today in Poland): without a section, the sections of catalogs 1a and 1ae with their group counts; with catalog and section, that section's groups with base points.

tools.name: compare_jgp_group
tools.description: Compare one JGP group between the catalogs in force on two service dates: act and release on each side, name, base points, scopes and the names of the directional lists its conditions use, plus the list of fields that changed. Read full conditions with get_jgp_group.

tools.name: get_case_dictionaries
tools.description: The legal dictionaries a stay for group_case needs: ward specialty codes (the VIII part of a department code; hospital wards 4000-4951 by default, wards="all" for every section) and discharge modes, each with its legal act, plus the accepted hospitalization types and product reporting values.

tools.name: group_case
tools.description: Run the Minos Gruper (JGP SZP, supported rule subset) on one anonymised hospital stay: candidate groups with status and reasons, the ranking, base and final points with tariff modifiers when bound, the preparation (procedure outcomes, ward-adjusted days, products), underivable groups and limitations

tools.name: get_source_status
tools.description: What a watched publisher shows now, as Minos last observed it: RSK (Rejestr Systemów Kodowania) resources and files, BAW NFZ orders and their attachments, or NFZ dictionaries and notices, with versions, publication dates and observation times. Compare with get_service_info for the versions Minos ser
